CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

2. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

3. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

4. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Javelin and Sculpture.
   B. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.
   D. Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   C. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   D. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   D. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.

8. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   B. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   C. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

9. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

10. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.

11. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The speed of the music

12. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Javelin and Sculpture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Handball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. B — Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. C — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

4. D — Practise Javelin and Sculpture with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. D — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. D — Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. A — Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. C — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. B — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. A — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. D — The speed of the music

12. C — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

15. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
